id.description: Stable identifier. Lowercase country prefix, underscore, slug.

language.description: ISO 639-1 where one exists, otherwise ISO 639-3

audience_rank.description: Rank of the outlet by audience within its country, 1 = largest. Set from a readership source; unset means unknown. The share of all published items metric uses the 30 best ranked outlets of a country when ranks exist, otherwise every active outlet.

collector.description: Which collector polls this outlet. hosted (default) is the GitHub-hosted runner; self_hosted is the runner on the owner's own network, for feeds that refuse GitHub's addresses.

section_feeds.description: Press release, sponsored and partner sections that editorial RSS usually leaves out, found by pipeline/discover_sections.py. type rss is a feed; type page is the section's index page, read for article links. Items from these sections skip the relevance gate; classification decides.

type.description: rss: a feed. page: a section index page whose article links are read like feed entries.

release_sections.description: Whether the outlet's site was searched for press release, sponsored or partner sections, when, and what was found. Unsearched outlets have no entry. The flag is a finding: state origin can only be found where the route was looked for.

readable.description: Whether the collector could read the section when last verified. Unreadable sections stay recorded but are not polled.

political_leaning.description: Editorial leaning judged against the outlet's own country's political spectrum, not a US or European one. unassessed when no reliable source was found; never inferred from the name, language or country.

leaning_source.description: URL of the source for political_leaning.

ownership.description: private; public_service, a public broadcaster with statutory editorial independence; state, government controlled or state owned without editorial independence; party, owned by a political party; unassessed.

ownership_source.description: URL of the source for ownership.

rank_source.description: URL of the readership source behind audience_rank.
